dict.string: Petal needs Screen Recording access so you can choose which of your windows to share with your team. We never see or share anything you don't explicitly select.
Petal needs microphone access so your teammates can hear you during a call. Your mic is off until you join and unmute.
Petal needs camera access for your video tile so teammates can see you. Your camera stays off until you turn it on in a meeting.
Petal reads the address of a shared browser window so viewers can open the same page.
